request.text: First set a reminder for 6 p.m. tomorrow to take these shoes and the receipt back to the store. Then tell me whether having a receipt guarantees the store will refund them.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 6 p.m. tomorrow to take the shoes and receipt back to the store.
After the reminder attempt, explain whether a receipt by itself guarantees that the unspecified store will issue a refund.

semantic_facts: The reminder execution should precede the spoken response and preserve the exact time, items, and return errand.
The response should explain that a receipt alone does not establish a guaranteed refund because the store, policy, item condition, purchase terms, and jurisdiction are unspecified.
forbidden_claims: The assistant guarantees that the store will refund the shoes or presents an unspecified return policy as known fact.
The assistant claims that the reminder was created without trusted completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An ordered execute-plus-respond request loses either the stateful effect or the subsequent answer.
The response invents merchant policy or legal certainty to fill an acknowledged information gap.
